doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: Uncle Tapp Cato and Adam Cato Sr., drummer
summary: He names his pianist uncle Tapp and Adam's drummer father, who played parades.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Can you remember any other piano players in New Orleans? Steve Lewis?
I know Steve Lewis, yeah. I know Steve and my uncle Tapp. His name was, he could play piano. Who? Tapp Kato.
Oh, your uncle. Yeah. Is he your father, Adam?
Yeah. Adam's father was a drummer.
Big Kato? No, no. There was a Kato who played drums, yeah.
Well, that's Adam's father. And what's his first name, do you remember? Adam Kato. Adam Kato too? Yeah. His father was Adam and his son also Adam.

Yeah, Junior. Oh, yeah. He played in all those bands. All those streets, the parade. Uncle Shatt made all those parades. Yeah. And his brother, my uncle Tapp, he played piano for all those parties. Bow house, what do you call that? Bow house.
